title: Automated Project Synthesis for Global Engineering
business: Global engineering firms managing complex, multi-site infrastructure projects.
problem: Project managers lose significant time manually aggregating status updates from disparate emails, meeting transcripts, and technical specifications stored across SharePoint sites, leading to delayed reporting.
solution: Implementing Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) enables automated grounding in organizational data via Microsoft Graph and Work IQ, allowing managers to query project status across all internal documents and communications without manual file consolidation.
steps: Assign Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) licenses to project management staff.
Configure SharePoint Advanced Management to clean up inactive sites and ensure data quality.
Use Microsoft Purview to classify sensitive technical specifications to ensure compliance.
Instruct users to access Copilot within Microsoft 365 apps to synthesize project status reports from existing Graph-indexed data.
outcome: Project managers achieve a unified view of project health by querying the AI directly, significantly reducing the time spent on manual information retrieval and synthesis.
limitation: Copilot responses are only as accurate as the underlying organizational data; if SharePoint sites are cluttered with outdated documents, the AI may surface irrelevant or obsolete information, which can be checked by reviewing the source citations provided in the Copilot response.
